Detailed description

NISAR – AI-Powered Earth Observation App 🌍

Our project is an AI-powered Earth Observation App designed to help people explore and understand Earth's surface using satellite data from the NISAR mission, a joint project of NASA (USA) and ISRO (India).

NISAR stands for NASA–ISRO Synthetic Aperture Radar. It uses advanced radar technology to observe Earth's surface during both day and night, even through clouds. It collects important information about changes in land, forests, glaciers, water and other natural features.

Our app is being developed using Emergent.sh, an AI-powered app-building platform. It aims to convert complex satellite information into simple maps and visual displays that everyone can understand.

Main Features of Our App

Interactive Earth Map: Allows users to explore different locations on Earth.

Satellite Data Display: Shows available NISAR satellite measurements.

Surface Change Detection: Helps users explore changes in Earth's surface over time.

Environmental Monitoring: Supports the study of forests, glaciers, land and water.

AI Explanation: Uses AI to explain satellite data in simple language.

Location-Based Exploration: Allows users to select an area and explore available satellite observations.

Purpose of the Project

The main purpose is to make advanced space technology useful and understandable to everyone. It can help students, researchers and scientists explore Earth's changes and learn more about environmental conditions.

Expected Impact

Better understanding of natural disasters.

Awareness about climate change.

Monitoring of forests and the environment.

Support for scientific learning and research.

Increased awareness about protecting our planet.

Our Vision: To transform complex satellite data into simple and meaningful information, helping everyone understand our changing Earth.
